name: Kea
description: ISC Kea DHCPv4 server with DHCP-DDNS (D2), a loopback-only Control Agent and packaged HA hooks. Installed from Debian 13 packages with services masked until subnets, HA and migration are configured. Stork is not included.

notes.text: DHCP, D2 and Control Agent are masked after installation. Configure static addressing and subnets, migrate leases, then explicitly enable the required services.
Defaults to UDP sockets for DHCP relay. For directly attached clients, configure raw sockets. HA and TSIG/DDNS require manual configuration; see docs/scripts/kea.md.
Uses the Debian 13 Kea package version, not necessarily the latest upstream release. No web UI is bundled.
